messages:
jen: RFC follow-up: we need to decide where dashboard RBAC lives. Two options: pre-filter in the query plane (early auth) or post-filter in the console renderer. Pros/cons in thread.

jen: Short take: pre-filter wins on bandwidth and aggregate widgets; renderer-filter simplifies query nodes and centralizes redaction. High-cardinality tenants tilt toward pre-filter for cost savings.

rohit: numbers from the small staging run:
- prefilter: network egress -38%, median load time 240ms, query p95 increases slightly (+25ms)
- renderer-filter: median load 320ms, heavier payloads to browser but simpler server CPU.

li: prefilter means auth calls on each shard which could multiply auth latency. cache helps but TTL / invalidation with role updates is messy.

marta: from compliance: any prefilter path must emit audit events per-eval and we must ensure tenant ids are redacted in logs. Also need retention policy updates.

jen: proposal: a mixed strategy by widget type:
- summary/aggregates: prefilter at query layer to avoid heavy fanout and cut cost
- detail tables/entities: renderer-filter so queries stay broadly compatible and fewer auth evals
- global: auth-version header + short allowlist cache (8-12s) with async invalidation hook on role changes

rohit: agree. Also add runtime switch flag `rbac_mode` so we can flip modes per-panel during canary. Routing policy can be on request metadata.

li: rollout caveats: we must measure p99 under churn. I'll add synthetic role-change load test. Also simulate cache stampedes.

marta: I'll add an audit checklist to the RFC: required fields, redaction knobs, and sample log lines.

jen: rollout plan outline:
1) infra: add auth-version header + allowlist cache (small PR)
2) build runtime flag and per-panel routing config
3) canary aggregates on 10% traffic, monitor errors/cost/p95
4) widen if stable; fallback to renderer mode if auth-eval p95 > 150ms or audit errors rise

rohit: I'll owner perf dashboards and alerts. Suggested alert: auth-eval-p95 > 120ms or auth-errors +5%

li: I'll own the simulation harness and per-shard instrumentation.

marta: owning audit and compliance sign-off.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=console-query ring=10% release=rbac-hybrid-2025-01

jen: thanks all. I'll update the RFC doc with the hybrid decision and owners. Please drop any blockers here. :thumbsup:
